Sample Village Solar Pump Assistance Scheme
Issued by: Sample Department of Testing
Release date: 2026-01-15

1. Purpose
The scheme helps small farmers replace diesel irrigation pumps with solar pumps.

2. Eligibility
- The applicant must be a farmer aged 18 years or above.
- The applicant must own or lease up to 2 hectares of farmland.
- Annual family income must not exceed Rs. 3,00,000.
- Farmers who received a solar pump under any earlier scheme are not eligible.

3. Benefits
- A subsidy of 60 percent of the cost of one solar pump, up to Rs. 90,000.
- Free installation by an approved vendor.
- Five years of free maintenance.

4. Required Documents
- Proof of identity.
- Land ownership or lease record.
- Income certificate issued in the last 12 months.
- Bank account details for the subsidy transfer.

5. How to Apply
Submit the application form with the documents at the block office.
